newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Current Australian Takeovers (P to Z)- Sept 9.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Current Australian Takeovers (P to Z)- Sept 9.

text.p: TERMS: A$2.40 cash per share, to take the form of a
cash payment of A$2.30 together with a 10 cent fully franked special dividend to be declared by the offeree.
NOTES: Offeror proposes to acquire all the issued
capital of the offeree. Offer conditional upon 90 percent acceptance. Directors recommend shareholders accept the offer in the absence of a higher bid. Offeror is entitled to 96.77
TERMS: Four shares in the offeror for each share held
and three shares in the offeror for every two options held.
NOTES: Offeror proposes to acquire all the issued
capital of the offeree. The offer will be conditional upon necessary regulatory approvals in Canada and Australia and the approval of Mineral Resources shareholders.
TERMS: A$4 cash and 60 pre-consolidation Westgold
shares for every 100 Ramsgate shares or 100 Westgold pre-consolidation shares for every 100 Ramsgate shares held.
NOTES: Westgold is entitled to 55.66 percent of
Ramsgate. Directors recommend shareholders reject the offer. Offeror will not proceed with compulsory acquisition. The offer has now closed.
TERMS: Four Capital shares for every one Stirling share
and is conditional on minimum acceptances of 30 percent of Stirling shares.
NOTES: Capital is now entitled to 33.94 percent of
Stirling's issued capital. Independent Stirling directors have advised shareholders to reject the offer
TERMS: Three GUD shares for every eight Sunbeam shares
conditional on 90 percent acceptance. On July 9, offer increased to one share in the offeror and 54 cents cash for every three Sunbeam shares.
NOTES: GUD is now entitled to 84.05 percent of
Sunbeam's capital. Sunbeam directors advise shareholders to either sell shares on-market or accept the offer.
TERMS: A$2.30 cash per share ex-dividend and 15 cents
NOTES: Directors recommend shareholders not sell their
shares pending further advice. Offeror is now entitled to 17.94 percent of the offer.
TERMS: A$5.30 per share, raised from $4.85 cash per
NOTES: Offer conditional on 90 percent acceptance and
the All Ordinaries index not falling below 2000 points. Directors advise shareholders to reject the advised offer. Offeror is entitled to 5.02 percent of offeree.
